title: Freedom Yield Metal — Operator Identity Manifest v1
description: Formal contract for /api/identity.json. Revised 2026-06-20 as a pre-production correction; further extended 2026-06-21 with additive Merkle DAG anchor fields (dag_root_hash, cycles_history_url, anchor_receipt_url) for Phase α A-chain anchoring per docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md. See docs/IDENTITY_SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md for the full history. The model is an operator-signed artifact snapshot. The runtime manifest is generated and signed by scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh on the operator's local Mac, NEVER on the validator host or web host. Verification uses ssh-keygen -Y verify with namespace freedom-yield/validator-identity. Companion /api/identity.example.json is a synthetic schema example, NOT a production snapshot. Companion design changelog: docs/IDENTITY_SCHEMA_CHANGELOG.md. The schema URL is a stable discovery endpoint; consumers that need immutable schema semantics SHOULD pin the schema document SHA-256 or the repository commit (see CHANGELOG). A future breaking change will use a new major-version schema URL; retention and deprecation policy for superseded schema versions will be documented when such a version is introduced.

x-revision-history.summary: Pre-production correction baseline. Re-grounded the contract for /api/identity.json prior to first signed publication; established additive-only-within-v1 stability commitment.

Additive within v1: Merkle DAG anchor fields dag_root_hash / cycles_history_url / anchor_receipt_url for Phase α A-chain anchoring per docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md. All new fields are optional; pre-Phase-α identity.json publications remain valid against this schema unchanged.

Additive within v1: audit object grouping anchor_receipt + anchor_history URL pointers. audit holds plain URLs only; identity.json MUST NOT carry a hash of anchor-receipt.json or anchor-history.jsonl (= circular hash dependency avoided). When the legacy top-level anchor_receipt_url is present alongside audit.anchor_receipt, both URLs MUST be equal.

node_id_authority.description: Authoritative explorer URL where the NodeID's registration can be cross-checked.

site.description: Canonical site URL the operator controls.

operator_identity_pubkey_url.description: URL where the operator identity ed25519 public key is published (typically /.well-known/operator-identity.pub).

operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint.description: OpenSSH SHA-256 fingerprint of the operator identity public key, e.g., 'SHA256:abc123…'. A consumer can compute the same fingerprint via 'ssh-keygen -l -f operator-identity.pub' and compare.

key_iat.description: When this operator identity key was issued (became authoritative).

key_exp.description: Recommended expiry; operator-declared, NOT cryptographically enforced. Consumers may treat as policy.

revoked.description: true iff this key is no longer authoritative for the brand+node_id. When true, revoked_at + revocation_reason SHOULD be populated.

artifact_manifest.description: Merkle-rooted artifact manifest: each entry binds a leaf artifact's URL to its content sha256, and (where applicable) its schema URL and schema sha256. A consumer fetches each entry's url, computes sha256(content), and compares to entry.sha256. The set is committed to as a whole by artifact_root (see below). Additive: new artifacts may appear in this map within v1.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the artifact's raw bytes as published.

artifact_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root computed over artifact_manifest entries: leaves are each entry.sha256, ordered alphabetically by key, odd counts duplicate the last leaf, parents are SHA-256(left || right) as raw bytes, hex-encoded at the root. In identity.example.json this field is set to all-zeros (sixty-four '0' characters) to indicate the schema-only preview state; the production runtime identity.json carries the real 64-hex Merkle root after gen-identity.sh computes it from the live artifact bytes. NOTE: artifact_root commits to the CURRENT set of published artifacts; dag_root_hash (additive field, see below) commits to the CUMULATIVE Merkle DAG of identity-key history and validation-cycle history. Both roots coexist within v1; they serve different evidentiary purposes and are independently verifiable.

dag_root_hash.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α, 2026-06-21). 64-hex SHA-256(raw_bytes(identity_branch_root) || raw_bytes(cycles_branch_root)). The value anchored on Metal A-chain via memo 'fyid1:<dag_root_hash>'. MUST equal cycles-history.json.dag_root_hash and anchor-receipt.json.dag_root_hash for the same publication moment. Construction is specified in docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md and is bit-for-bit equivalent to the existing compute_merkle_root shell function at scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh L186-230 applied to the per-branch leaf hashes, then combined per MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md §4. Absent on identity.json publications produced before Phase α activation.

cycles_history_url.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α, 2026-06-21). URL of /api/cycles-history.json — the Merkle DAG snapshot summarising the two branch roots whose combination is dag_root_hash. Lets verifiers discover the DAG breakdown without parsing identity.json's flat fields.

anchor_receipt_url.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α, 2026-06-21). URL of /api/anchor-receipt.json — the most recent A-chain inscription receipt anchoring this dag_root_hash. MAY be absent between the moment a new dag_root_hash is computed and the moment its anchoring inscription confirms on-chain. From 2026-06-23 also exposed inside the additive `audit` object as `audit.anchor_receipt`; consumers MAY use either pointer (they MUST equal each other when both are present).

audit.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α completion, 2026-06-23). Stable pointer object grouping the off-manifest evidence URLs. By keeping these as URL pointers, identity.json itself stays a rotation-driven snapshot (= no per-cycle churn of identity.json's signed bytes); the dynamic per-cycle artifacts live behind these stable URLs. Anti-pattern explicitly avoided: identity.json MUST NOT contain a hash of /api/anchor-receipt.json (or anchor-history.jsonl) because anchor-receipt.json itself references identity.json's dag_root_hash — that would create a circular hash dependency. The `audit` object holds plain URLs only.

anchor_receipt.description: URL of /api/anchor-receipt.json — the most recent live anchor's receipt. When present alongside the legacy top-level anchor_receipt_url, both URLs MUST be equal (= consistency invariant verified by gen-identity.sh).

anchor_history.description: URL of /api/anchor-history.jsonl — the append-only ledger of every anchor that has reached verification_status == 'live'. Validated per-line against /api/anchor-history.schema.v1.json. MAY point at a not-yet-existing artifact between identity.json regeneration and the first live anchor; consumers should treat HTTP 404 as 'in preparation' in that window. See project memory project_phase_alpha_anchor_completion_2026_07_04 for the gated transition.
